ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 55% high-intensity (white/light grey) and 45% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixel distribution.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the distal thirds of both lobes. The medial region surrounding the notch consists of a solid low-intensity black blob that radiates into high-frequency black mottling across the lower sections of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped notch with an approximate vertex angle of 40 degrees, situated at the central vertical axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge. Notable jagged peaks with pixel-amplitudes varying between 10-30 pixels relative to the mean edge curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep trajectory observed on the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to acute, upwardly-curved distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-intensity white circular pixels (barnacle colonies) are prominent on the extreme distal tips of both left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A series of at least four dark, parallel linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible on the distal half of the right lobe. A single vertical, medium-intensity linear mark is located in the dark central-left region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of Coronula-type barnacles on the fluke tips and distinct predatory rake marks on the right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique vertical light-colored scar situated in the dark pigmentation zone to the left of the median notch.
